question: NVLink 4.0 (H100) 的双向带宽为 900 GB/s，NVLink 3.0 (A100) 的双向带宽为 600 GB/s。相比 PCIe，NVLink 将 AllReduce 延迟降低至 PCIe 方案的 1/10 至 1/15，使得多卡推理的通信开销占比从 20%-40% 降至 5%-10% [待核验]。

sources.snippet: NVLink 4.0 Architecture Overview NVLink 4.0 provides 900 GB/s of bidirectional bandwidth per connection with a scale of 8 per H100. It is used in H100, GH200 clusters and supports GPU-GPU within node.

sources.title: DGX H100 Topology: NVLink, NVSwitch & Inter-Node Networking
sources.snippet: Each H100 GPU features 18 NVLink 4 links, providing a total of 900 GB/s of bidirectional bandwidth per GPU. This bandwidth is critical for scaling workloads like Tensor Parallelism, where weights or activations are partitioned across GPUs slides/9.

sources.title: H100 NVLink优势：TB/s级互联带来性能飞跃 - CSDN博客
sources.snippet: 文章浏览阅读833次，点赞7次，收藏19次。NVIDIA H100搭载NVLink实现900 GB/s互联带宽，显著提升多卡协同效率，突破大模型训练中的通信瓶颈。结合Transformer Engine与统一显存池，支持高效张量并行与梯度同步，使训练吞吐提升数倍，推动AI算力迈向集群化与内存池化新时代。
